figurative_meaning_en: Consistency in actions, harmony in proportion or synchronization
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোমার কথায় ও কাজে কোন তালমিল নেই।
দুই ভাইয়ের মধ্যে পুরো তালমিল আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There is no harmony between your words and actions.
There is complete synchronization between the two brothers.
note: Derived from musical rhythm, commonly used in colloquial Bengali to denote alignment in behavior or efforts.
